scope: Machine QA protocol snapshot, optimistic measurement revision, evaluate replay and TrendPoint uniqueness
implementation: The synthetic seed endpoint reuses the organization-scoped MACHINE_QA_BASELINE v1 instead of creating a second protocol or rule set.
New runs persist the p11.protocol-snapshot.v1 payload with source, capability and complete rule fields before evaluation.
Evaluate accepts optional expected_revision for backward compatibility; a stale DRAFT revision returns MACHINE_QA_REVISION_CONFLICT without evaluating.
PostgreSQL finalization locks the Machine QA run row; a completed replay returns the stored immutable snapshot and does not create additional TrendPoint rows.
The web client evaluates with the measurement_revision returned by the autosave response.
